Battery-powered illuminated promotional counter — up to 24h of operation
adTribune Pop-up Battery is an illuminated promotional counter powered by a battery. It can shine for up to 24 hours, which means two full trade show days without charging and without connecting the counter to power. You can place it anywhere on your stand or in the exhibition hall — in the middle of the space, near the entrance, in a communication aisle or in the area where you talk to customers — and stop worrying about access to a socket.
The battery is included in the set, and you can check its level on the percentage display placed at the bottom of the structure, next to the counter feet. A full charge takes around 5 hours.
The pop-up system also makes assembly faster and easier. Just lift the folded structure, attach the support and the print, and the counter is ready to use. The tabletop also features a built-in wireless charger, so you can charge your phone during the event.

Advantages
More freedom when setting up your stand
Battery power gives you much more freedom when planning the space. The counter does not have to stand next to a wall, an extension cord or the nearest power source. You can place it where visitors naturally stop or where your team talks to customers.
Intuitive tool-free assembly
The adTribune Pop-up Battery structure is based on the pop-up system known from other counters in this series. You do not have to assemble it from separate elements — the whole structure opens automatically when you lift the frame up. All you need to add is the support and the print.
Charger always within reach
The tabletop includes a built-in wireless charger that lets you charge your phone during the event. Simply place your smartphone in the marked area on the tabletop to top up the battery while talking to customers, presenting your offer or working at the stand.

adTribune Pop-up Battery — every event detail taken care of
adTribune Pop-up Battery has everything you need for a successful event. It is tool-free, self-sufficient and visible from a distance.
To turn on the counter lighting, simply press the button placed on the side of the frame. Battery power removes the need to connect it to electricity during the event. You can check the charge level on the percentage display at the bottom of the structure, next to the counter feet — so it is easy to see how much energy is left and whether you need to plan charging after the workday is over.
A full charge takes around 5 hours, and after that the counter can shine for up to 24 hours. That gives you a comfortable reserve for a full day of work, and for shorter events — also for the next use.
The sides of the counter are painted white, so they match the battery container and the whole product looks consistent even up close. The textile print can be replaced before your next campaigns, product launches or events, while you keep using the same structure.
The model is available as a complete set with a battery and as a print only.

A large promotional counter you can set up in one move
adTribune Quick Max is one of the largest models in the Quick counter family. It has a larger format, but uses the same system known from the other variants — pneumatic, without an electric unfolding mechanism. Simply lift the tabletop and the structure positions itself correctly, ready for use.
With Quick Max, you gain more space for serving customers, presenting materials and holding conversations, without wasting time on complicated assembly.

Advantages
Larger format, more room to work
When is it most worth choosing Quick Max? When more than one person works at the counter or when you need space for catalogues, product samples, a tablet or documents for visitors. A larger counter means more tabletop space and a larger display area that can be printed with your own graphic design. Its impressive size also helps make the service point on your stand more visible — the counter becomes easier to notice and naturally organises the space around it.
Mobile and ready to use in seconds
The pneumatic mechanism reduces the setup process to one simple movement. Just lift the tabletop, and the frame unfolds and stabilises itself in the correct position. You do not need tools or extra assistance. The counter can quickly go from its bag to a ready-to-use service point, and after the event it can just as easily return to a transport-ready form.
Durable, replaceable print
The sublimation process we use for printing makes the ink penetrate directly into the fabric structure, so the graphic retains vivid colours and withstands frequent use well. Best of all, you can replace the print before each new campaign, product launch or trip to another trade fair, while continuing to use the same structure. You change the message, but keep working with the same proven system.

One promotional counter, many work scenarios
adTribune Quick Max works well at events that require a larger point of contact with the audience. It can serve as a reception desk on a stand, an information point, a place for presenting an offer or a space for sales conversations. The larger tabletop makes everyday team work easier, while the large graphic area helps maintain consistent brand communication.
The model is available as a complete set, print only or frame only. You can adapt the configuration to your current needs and freely refresh the counter’s look for future projects.

A square promotional counter you can set up in seconds
The adTribune Quick Square expands the Quick series with a completely new form based on clean lines and sharp edges. Its square shape fits perfectly into modular displays and geometry-based layouts, while the pneumatic structure allows for setup in just moments. Simply lift the countertop slightly, and the whole unit automatically unfolds into position. It’s an indispensable solution for trade fairs, conferences, and promotional events.

Advantages
Instant setup
The pneumatic system significantly simplifies preparation. Just gently lift the countertop, and the structure unfolds and stabilizes on its own. What’s more, the counter is delivered with a pre-installed print, so it’s ready to use immediately after setup—no extra adjustments needed on site.
Clear, geometric form
The square shape helps organize space and match the counter with other display elements. You can easily place it against a wall, in a walkway, or integrate it into a larger exhibition. This gives you greater control over your booth layout, ensuring a clean and cohesive look for visitors.
Durable, eco-friendly print
We use sublimation printing in the production process. This method allows the dye to penetrate directly into the fabric structure under high temperature, rather than remaining on its surface. As a result, the graphic becomes an integral part of the material. In practice, this means vivid colors, well-defined details, and no cracking or peeling over time. It performs well during frequent use and transport and is more environmentally friendly than traditional printing methods.

One form, many possibilities
The adTribune Quick Square easily adapts to various event scenarios. It can serve as a registration desk, information point, product presentation area, or meeting space. Depending on the graphic design, it changes its character and fits the context of the event.
The model is available as a complete set, print only, or structure only. This allows you to easily swap graphics and use the same counter in different versions without ordering a new system each time.
